👮 Criminal Justice & Policing
OH HB 1033 — Ohio Could Make It a Crime to Post Police Info Online

Ohio is considering a law that would make it a felony to intentionally post a peace officer’s personal information online. The bill would target those who share details like social security numbers, addresses, or financial information with the intent to harm, harass, or cause significant economic or emotional distress to the officer or their family. ...
